row_guide: Band0 (y0–768): stairwells, pillars, white/lilac floor tiles, yellow platform edges, elevators/doors, turnstiles, drink/coffee machines, map/arrow signs, benches & waiting seats, plants; blue/white subway exterior+interior+seats/controls. Band1 (y768–1536): orange/brown vintage, green commuter (red+green buckets), and grey/silver modern train exterior/interior kits with seats & cabs. Band2 (y1536–2304): white/teal high-speed LME train, graffiti subway car, brown/grey rail modulars, named graffiti/posters/cracks, luggage/trolleys, trash & busker props, control desk. Band3 (y2304–2960): tunnel portals/arches, binary hazard edges, isometric diamond/chevron stairs, blue/orange platform number UI, top-down vehicles.
